hooks.command: input=$(cat); fp=$(python -c "import json,sys; d=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path','') or d.get('tool_response',{}).get('filePath',''))" "$input"); case "$fp" in *.claude/*) set -a; [ -f .env ] && source .env; set +a; PYTHONPATH=infra python -m agent_registry.manage sync ;; esac
